Select approved drugs (max_phase_for_ind = 4) indicated for multiple myeloma. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Filter drug_indication.mesh_heading or efo_term for 'multiple myeloma'. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles (INNER JOIN compound_structures), indication_curie (efo_id), indication_label (efo_term or mesh_heading), and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind.
